voice:
Get comfortable, and let your eyes close. We start with your grip.
Your shoulders. Let them drop... let them hang... nothing held there anymore.
Your jaw. Let it unclench... teeth apart, tongue resting soft.
Your hands. Open your fingers one by one... palms up, empty, nothing left to carry.
Your belly. Soft and round... no holding it in, no effort at all.
Your legs. Heavy... loose... settled wherever they rest.
There. Your body has let go of everything it was gripping.
Now the same for your mind... because the mind grips too, doesn't it.
Whatever is in your head right now, imagine setting each thought down... like heavy bags after a long day.
A bag for the errands... set down. A bag for the worries... set down. A bag for everybody else's opinions... set down.
The whole day, filed away in its drawer... nothing left to hold, nothing left to sort.
And with every bag you set down, your arms feel lighter... and your attention drifts softer and softer toward my voice. And with every bag you set down, your mind grows quieter... and my voice grows closer and warmer. And with every bag you set down, everything unnecessary slides off you... leaving only comfort, and my voice.
Nothing left to grip. Nothing left to do... except fall.
Sissy Drop.
That's it... all the way down... soft, deep, and completely let go.
Deeper and deeper now, sweet girl... drifting exactly where you belong.
